Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Collaboration team helps Stripe employees work smarter and more efficiently, get to know each other, and request and receive help from one another. The team is nimble and creative. We work across a wide stack; on any given day, we discuss user interface design, data models, API design, infrastructure maintenance, agentic integrations, or all of the above. We’re excited to innovate in a space that traditionally isn’t thought of as in the forefront of innovation.

Being a small team, we carefully choose what we work on to have the highest leverage. This is not always easy—we work very cross-functionally, partnering with groups from engineering to Communications to senior leadership. But one of our greatest rewards is getting to sit next to and see the impact our work has on our users: our fellow Stripe employees.

What you’ll do

As an engineer on Stripe’s Collaboration team, you will be a key member of a team that acts as a force multiplier on the internal tools that Stripe uses. You will focus on building innovative AI-native experiences that help Stripe employees be more productive across various tasks and activities. You’ll collaborate with other teams across Stripe, combine traditional hands-on engineering with emerging AI capabilities, and experiment with different ideas and approaches to empower and delight your users.

Responsibilities

  • Work with a team of smart, motivated engineers who put their users first.
  • Own solutions from end to end, managing complexity and engaging directly with stakeholders to think through everything from success metrics to MCP tooling to the nitty-gritty implementation details of the products you build.
  • Leverage the latest AI tooling to refine and optimize both your users’ workflows and your own.
  • Use both qualitative and quantitative metrics to determine priorities and measure effectiveness.
  • Uphold Stripe’s high standards for engineering and product quality and mentor newer team members to do the same.

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • You have 6+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 2+ years of industry experience building rich web experiences using modern frameworks such as React, Vue, etc.
  • You work well across a full stack, from user experience to workflow automations to reliability. 
  • You enjoy working directly with users and cross-functional partners to build creative solutions that address their problems.
  • You are able to think rigorously, navigate ambiguity, and make hard decisions and tradeoffs.
  • You enjoy working together with your team toward common goals, but are also able to drive your work forward autonomously

Preferred qualifications

  • You have a passion for enabling people to do their best work.
  • You have an interest in partnering with creative, non-technical teams, such as those responsible for Stripe’s creative communications and publishing efforts.
  • You have a track record of shipping LLM-powered experiences with a strong understanding of how underlying technologies work.
  • You have industry experience working with Ruby, TypeScript, and React.
  • You are experienced with using AI tools to maximize your technical throughput while maintaining a high bar for quality.
  • You never lose sight of the end user, and you enjoy the quick feedback loops made possible by working (sometimes literally) next to your users.

At Breeze, we're building the AI-powered infrastructure layer for global commerce, making it radically simpler for businesses to sell, get paid, and operate across markets.

We go far beyond traditional payment processing. Breeze combines global payments, AI, stablecoins, and a Merchant of Record-like model to take on the complexity businesses typically manage themselves, including compliance, risk, fraud, chargebacks, reconciliation, and customer support.

Our goal is simple: let businesses focus on building and selling great products while Breeze handles the complexity behind getting paid.

Backed by Sequoia Capital, Multicoin Capital, and The Chainsmokers, Breeze is a successful, rapidly growing, and exceptionally well-capitalized company. We have the runway to think long term while remaining early enough that every person joining today can have a meaningful impact on what we build.

We are hiring a Compliance Operations Specialist to join our team!


As our Compliance Operations Specialist, you'll run the day-to-day operations of our compliance program and make sure our processes are accurate, efficient, and aligned with regulatory standards across every market we serve. You'll own the KYC, AML, and BSA workflows that keep Breeze safe and auditable as we scale. Reporting to the Head of Compliance. 

We're looking for someone who thrives in fast-moving environments, wants meaningful ownership, and is excited to build rather than simply maintain.

What You'll Do

  • Review and approve user KYC cases.
  • Investigate transaction monitoring alerts and escalate suspicious activity.
  • Review sanctions and PEP screening alerts.
  • Screen crypto wallets and transactions for risk.
  • Run enhanced due diligence on high-risk users.
  • Support SAR drafting and escalation decisions.
  • Respond to information requests from partners, banks, and law enforcement.
  • Keep clear, audit-ready case records.
  • Suggest improvements to rules, tools, and processes.
  • Work with Risk, Fraud, Support, and Product on investigations.
  • Support EU compliance obligations, including regulatory filings and AML responsibilities tied to our EU CASP entity.

What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years in compliance at a fintech, payments, banking, or crypto company.
  • Hands-on KYC experience.
  • Strong AML knowledge, including BSA/AML and OFAC.
  • Transaction monitoring experience.
  • Crypto experience, including blockchain analytics tools.
  • Sanctions and PEP screening experience.
  • Strong attention to detail and clear written communication.
  • Comfortable in a fast-paced startup environment, without an established playbook.
  • A builder mentality with a strong bias toward action.
  • Excited to use AI and automation to work smarter and rethink existing processes.
  • Comfortable getting into the details and doing the work, regardless of seniority.

Nice to Have

  • Experience drafting SARs.
  • Experience with third-party KYC and fraud platforms.
  • Experience at an early-stage or high-growth startup.

Why Breeze

  • More than payments: We're building an intelligent infrastructure layer across payments, compliance, risk, fraud, chargebacks, reconciliation, and customer support.
  • AI from the ground up: AI isn't an add-on. It's central to how we're building our products and how our teams operate.
  • Successful and still early: We have meaningful traction and strong financial foundations while remaining early enough for new hires to have outsized impact.
  • Built for the long term: Backed by Sequoia Capital, Multicoin Capital, and The Chainsmokers, we're exceptionally well-capitalized with the runway to think big.
  • Real ownership: Lean teams, few layers, direct access to decision-makers, and the autonomy to make things happen.
  • Hard problems: Work at the intersection of AI, payments, stablecoins, risk, compliance, financial infrastructure, and global commerce.
  • Exceptional team: Work with ambitious, curious, low-ego people who move quickly and care deeply about what they build.
  • Room to grow: As Breeze grows, strong performers can quickly expand their scope and take on bigger problems.

How We Work

  • Act Now, Improve Later: Ship something real today. Move fast, learn from what happens, and make it better.
  • Disagree and Commit: Debate hard before a decision. Once it's made, commit fully and make the outcome right.
  • Customers First: When in doubt, start with what's most painful for the customer.
  • Own It, End to End: Don't wait to be asked. If you see a problem, take responsibility for solving it.
  • Default to Public: Share context openly so the whole team can move faster and learn from each other.
  • High Standards, Genuine Warmth: Hold the bar high and treat people well. Be direct, rigorous, kind, and low ego.
  • Outcomes Over Activity: We care about what ships, what works, and what moves the needle, not how busy you look.
  • AI Forward, Always Learning: Experiment with new tools, automate the repetitive, share what works, and continuously rethink how you can work smarter.

Compensation Philosophy

We believe compensation should be fair, competitive, consistent, and transparent.

  • We benchmark compensation against the market and establish thoughtful bands for each role.
  • Compensation reflects experience, skills, location, role scope, and expected impact.
  • We don't believe pay should primarily depend on how aggressively someone negotiates.
  • Eligible employees receive meaningful equity, so the people building Breeze can participate in the long-term value they help create.

Benefits & Perks

  • Health coverage: Breeze covers 100% of employee premiums on our competitive base plan and 75% of dependent premiums.
  • PTO: 21 days, plus applicable company holidays.
  • 401(k): Breeze covers all plan administration fees.
  • Equity: Meaningful ownership in the company you're helping build.
  • Equipment: A new MacBook Air and whatever else you need to do your best work.
  • Office & education allowance: An annual budget for your workspace, tools, and professional development.
  • Wellness: A monthly reimbursement to support your well-being.
  • Annual global offsite: We bring the global Breeze team together every year. Previous destinations include Bali and Singapore, with Japan coming next.

Location / Working Model

This role is remote in Bulgaria.

Why Join Breeze

  • Make an outsized impact: We're successful and still early, with meaningful traction and strong financial foundations. Lean teams, few layers, and direct access to decision-makers mean you'll have real ownership and the autonomy to make things happen.
  • Solve hard, meaningful problems: Work at the intersection of AI, payments, stablecoins, risk, compliance, financial infrastructure, and global commerce as we build an intelligent infrastructure layer that goes far beyond payments.
  • Build AI-first: AI isn't an add-on. It's central to how we're building our products and how our teams operate. You'll experiment with new tools, automate the repetitive, and continuously rethink how to work smarter.
  • Work with an exceptional team: Join ambitious, curious, low-ego people who move quickly, hold a high bar, and care deeply about what they build.
  • Grow with Breeze: As Breeze grows, strong performers can quickly expand their scope and take on bigger problems.
  • Build for the long term: Backed by Sequoia Capital, Multicoin Capital, and The Chainsmokers, we're exceptionally well-capitalized with the runway to think big.

In-Office Expectations

Employees based in our New York City, NY office follow a hybrid work model and are expected to work from the office three days per week. Employees based in our Singapore office are expected to work on-site five days per week.

In-office expectations may vary slightly depending on role, team, and business needs. Certain roles that require closer cross-functional collaboration or operational support may have additional requirements, which will be discussed during the interview process.

Our approach is designed to support meaningful in-person collaboration, team building, and real-time decision-making while providing flexibility where applicable. We believe this structure enables strong execution, close collaboration, and effective teamwork across our global offices.

Come Build With Us!

We offer a rare combination: the ownership and speed of an early-stage company with the traction, backing, and financial foundations of a successful business.

We're building at the convergence of AI, payments, stablecoins, financial infrastructure, and global commerce. The opportunity is much bigger than building another payment processor.

We're building the intelligent infrastructure layer for global commerce, and there's still an enormous amount left to build.

If you want meaningful ownership, hard problems, exceptional teammates, and the opportunity to help define what comes next, we'd love to hear from you!

GoMining runs a portfolio, not a single product: Digital Miners, the GOMINING token, GoMining Card, Simple Earn, Wallet, Miner Wars, Academy and more. As the business grows, so does the finance function behind it: more payment and service providers, more complex processes, more reporting, and more teams that depend on finance to move fast.

We’re looking for a Project Manager to join our Finance department and own the internal projects that make that function scale: process optimisation, reporting automation, new provider integrations, and coordination between finance and the rest of the company.

This is not a role for someone who only tracks tasks and books meetings. We need a PM who can dig into complex processes, spot what’s broken, propose a fix and drive the change through to a result. Many of these processes need to be built from scratch, so you’ll be shaping how things work, not just following an existing playbook.

The ideal candidate combines a strong Project Manager with a Business Operations mindset and a solid understanding of finance. If your background is in Finance Operations rather than pure project management, we’d still love to hear from you.

What you’ll do

Projects: own finance initiatives end to end

  • Lead internal finance projects from idea to result: scope, plan, stakeholders, timeline and delivery.
  • Drive the integration of new providers and systems into finance workflows, working with product, engineering, payments and accounting.
  • Hold the timeline and chase dependencies across departments so projects actually land on the date we committed to.
  • Communicate status, risks and results clearly to department heads and senior leadership.

Processes: make finance faster and more reliable

  • Map existing finance and accounting processes, find bottlenecks and manual work, and prioritise what to fix first.
  • Automate financial reporting and reduce the time and effort it takes to get reliable numbers.
  • Build new processes from scratch where none exist yet, keeping them lean and practical rather than bureaucratic.
  • Standardise how finance works with other teams: requests, handoffs, approvals and ownership.

Ownership: find problems before they find you

  • Proactively identify issues in processes and data, understand the root cause and come back with a solution, not just a ticket.
  • Read between the lines of stakeholder requests to understand what the business actually needs.
  • Take responsibility for outcomes instead of passing tasks between colleagues.

What success looks like

First 3 months: you know how finance works end to end, the key projects have a clear owner, plan and timeline, and the first process improvements or automations are live and saving the team real time.

  • 5+ years in project management, ideally in Finance or Operations.
  • Solid understanding of finance and accounting processes.
  • Hands-on experience with process automation, process optimisation and system integrations.
  • Experience working across multiple departments and aligning stakeholders you don’t manage.
  • A track record of running projects independently from idea to result: you can walk us through a project you owned and what changed because of it.
  • Strong ownership and proactivity: you don’t wait for instructions and you take responsibility for the outcome.
  • Confident communication with senior leaders.
  • Attention to detail and a systematic approach, balanced with pragmatism and no unnecessary bureaucracy.
  • Comfort with a high pace, a large workload, uncertainty and shifting priorities.
  • Strong English, written and spoken.

Would be a plus

  • Experience in Business Operations or Finance Operations roles.
  • Experience in crypto, fintech, payments or another fast-growing digital business.
  • Experience integrating payment or financial service providers.
  • Experience in a start-up or scale-up environment where processes were built from scratch.
  • Professional growth: support for courses, conferences, and English learning (up to 100% coverage).
  • Work-life fit: remote or hybrid format with flexible hours across international teams.
  • Paid leave: up to 20 vacation days + 8 company holidays + 5 personal days per year.
  • Recognition programs: structured performance reviews and team awards.
  • Team culture: retreats in international locations (for example, company apartments in Cyprus).

About SpruceID

SpruceID builds privacy-preserving, standards-based digital identity and credentialing solutions that give individuals control of their information while enabling governments and enterprises to deliver secure, interoperable services. We partner with public-sector organizations to modernize how identity is issued, verified, and used.

About the Role

As a Staff Forward Deployed Software Engineer, you will play a key role in delivering SpruceID's digital identity solutions to our customers and partners. You will lead medium- to large-scale technical projects, working closely with internal engineering teams and external stakeholders to ensure successful implementation and delivery.

This role combines hands-on software engineering, technical project leadership, and stakeholder collaboration. You'll work directly with customers to understand their requirements, translate business needs into technical solutions, and coordinate across teams to drive projects forward.

The ideal candidate brings strong technical expertise, experience independently leading complex engineering projects, and the ability to build trusted relationships with technical and non-technical stakeholders. You should be comfortable navigating ambiguity, managing competing priorities, and taking ownership of technical outcomes. Experience with digital identity, security, privacy, and credentialing technologies is highly valuable.

This job is fully remote within the US.

What You'll Do

  • Lead medium- to large-scale software engineering projects from requirements gathering and technical planning through implementation, deployment, and ongoing maintenance.

  • Work closely with internal and external stakeholders to understand requirements, align priorities, manage expectations, and ensure successful project delivery.

  • Own technical design and implementation decisions, ensuring solutions are scalable, secure, maintainable, and aligned with customer needs.

  • Collaborate with engineering, product, and delivery teams to coordinate dependencies, resolve blockers, and deliver high-quality solutions.

  • Serve as a key technical point of contact for customers and partners, communicating project progress, technical decisions, risks, and recommendations.

  • Architect, develop, and maintain backend systems, full-stack web applications, and integrations supporting SpruceID's digital identity solutions.

  • Translate complex customer requirements into clear technical specifications and actionable implementation plans.

  • Proactively identify technical risks, project dependencies, and opportunities to improve delivery efficiency.

  • Support integrations with customer infrastructure, third-party services, and legacy systems.

  • Contribute to code reviews, technical documentation, testing, and engineering best practices.

  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to other engineers, fostering collaboration and knowledge sharing.

  • Partner with internal teams to share customer feedback and contribute to product and platform improvements.

Qualifications

  • 7+ years of professional software engineering experience, including designing, building, and maintaining production-grade applications.

  • Proven experience independently leading medium- to large-scale engineering projects, coordinating multiple teams and driving technical initiatives from planning through delivery.

  • Strong stakeholder management experience, including working directly with customers, gathering requirements, aligning expectations, and communicating effectively across technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Proficiency in one or more statically typed programming languages such as Rust, Go, Java, or C#.

  • Strong understanding of software architecture, backend development, APIs, system integrations, and cloud infrastructure.

  • Experience making technical design decisions, evaluating tradeoffs, and solving complex engineering challenges.

  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, including engineering, product, and delivery.

  • Ability to navigate ambiguity, manage competing priorities, and take ownership of outcomes with minimal oversight.

  • Excellent problem-solving, communication, and organizational skills.

  • Experience working directly with customers or external partners in technical delivery or implementation environments.

  • Based in the US and willing to travel as needed to support customer engagements (should not be much).

Bonus Qualifications

  • Experience with digital identity, verifiable credentials, digital wallets, or identity verification solutions.

  • Knowledge of privacy-preserving technologies, authentication protocols, security standards, and interoperability frameworks.

  • Experience working with public-sector organizations, government agencies, or highly regulated industries.

  • Familiarity with SpruceID's technology ecosystem and standards-based digital identity solutions.

  • Experience leading complex integrations involving multiple systems, vendors, or external partners.

  • Familiarity with accessibility, compliance, and legacy system modernization.

  • Experience mentoring engineers or providing technical leadership across project teams.

  • Background in forward deployed engineering, solutions engineering, technical consulting, or other customer-facing engineering roles.

Equal Opportunity

At SpruceID, we value diversity of perspectives and backgrounds. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or veteran status.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. About the role

The Senior Intelligence Analyst owns TRM’s blockchain intelligence for a priority coverage area. You turn on-chain tracing, OSINT, and diverse intel signals into finished intelligence across scam/fraud, counter-narcotics, and facilitation and money laundering. You lead industry-leading work against professional money laundering organizations, illicit gambling networks, and related actors.

What is unique here: you build the AI-driven pipelines that turn many signals into attribution, making one of TRM’s highest-priority coverage areas a strength.

The impact you will have

  • Deepen TRM’s coverage by owning your area end-to-end and delivering finished, source-cited intelligence products across multiple threat categories.

  • Build end-to-end AI capability that processes a wide variety of intel signals and augments target selection, so you generate leads faster and at greater scale.

  • Trace funds across chains and through obfuscation, and correlate on-chain activity with OSINT, including Mandarin-language sources, to attribute money laundering organizations, threat actors, and gambling networks.

  • Drive attribution and leads that improve delivery in Mission (scam/fraud), Counter Narcotics, Nation States, and Facilitation and Money Laundering.

  • Set ambitious, industry-leading targets for your coverage area and raise the bar on tradecraft.

  • Build reusable AI pipelines and methods the broader Intelligence team adopts.

What we’re looking for

  • 5 to 8+ years in blockchain intelligence, crypto investigations, threat intelligence, or financial-crime investigations.

  • Strong OSINT and off-chain investigative tradecraft: you connect on-chain activity to real-world people, companies, and networks. Hands-on blockchain tracing experience is a plus, not a requirement; we train strong investigators on our tooling.

  • Domain expertise in professional money laundering organizations, illicit gambling networks, and underground banking.

  • Mandarin Chinese fluency is a strong plus.

  • Production AI fluency: you build end-to-end pipelines that process diverse intel signals and augment target selection, and you critically evaluate the output.

  • A track record of independently running complex investigations and producing clear, source-cited written intelligence.

  • US-based preferred, not required.

  • You will join TRM’s Blockchain Intelligence (Primary Intelligence) organization, a distributed team producing finished intelligence across threat categories.

  • The work is intellectually demanding: you keep real investigative proficiency across on-chain and OSINT tradecraft while owning a priority coverage area.

  • Mission-first, high-autonomy, execution-oriented culture with rigorous analytical standards.

  • AI-native team: analysts build reusable pipelines the whole team adopts.

Team Operating Rhythms

  • Distributed, not distant: a US-based analyst collaborating across time zones with regular overlap for syncs.

  • Slack-first, async communication; @mention for timely responses.

  • Weekly 1:1s and team syncs, plus case and category rhythms.

  • Schedule: Occasional travel for team engagements.

  • Schedule: None required; distributed/remote role.

Learn about TRM Speed in this position

  • Within your first 30 days, take ownership of an active case in your coverage area and deliver a finished, source-cited intelligence product.

  • Within 90 days, measurably deepen coverage against money laundering organizations or gambling networks, with attribution and leads that support cross-category delivery.

Application Instructions

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.

Interviewing with TRM

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

  • Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

  • Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

  • First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

  • Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

  • References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.

  • Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.

  • Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

  • Accelerate repeatable workflows

  • Structure and solve problems

  • Improve output quality

  • Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

  • Priorities and targets to change quickly

  • Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

  • A high level of personal ownership and accountability

  • Close collaboration across teams and functions

  • Frequent, high-touch communication

  • Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

  • A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute.

Leadership Principles

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

  • Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

  • Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

  • Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore.
